context_policy.rule: V7 is the single final destination. The repository is in temporary post-cleanup repair: do not restore V3-V6 wholesale and do not delete further cutover dependencies. Recover only required primitives into V7/common/control-plane, then require one exact SHA through tests, same-SHA PAPER, main, paper-validated, deploy and server health before any remaining legacy retirement.

grafana.rule: Legacy champion dashboards are not canonical. Rebuild one V7 economic monitoring plane as part of the same-SHA cutover; monitoring absence is a blocker to deployment readiness, not a successful steady state.

security.rule: SSH private keys and other credentials must remain outside version control.
